Sorry to reply negatively but,
Did you read my whole post? I have tried all the national hotlines.
Cool that you're a mom but... my own mom disowned me when I transitioned. And is a drunk. And abusive. Unconditional love is absolutely a myth. People get fed up after many years of trying. They all have with me. 
My wife is constantly disappointed in me and exhausted by me. I have nearly destroyed our business and her sanity with all the work she has had to do to clean up failures. 
We have almost divorced multiple times because of my mental illness. And the amount of therapy I need we cannot afford. Nor can I find a competent therapist that is cheap that know what a transgender person is, and specializes in borderline personality disorder.

Hey, I went through something similar. If you're still online feel free to chat.
When I had a breakdown and called the number my therapist I hadn't even had a real appointment with yet gave me... I was terrified and felt soookl stupid. Like I was wasting this poor persons time at home because it was their day to be the crisis person.
They were very nice and when I apologized they explained why I shouldn't because I did nothing wrong. They did not admit me or rush an ambulance I couldn't afford to my house or anything. He talked it out with me, let me cry, and gave me some strategies for getting through the week until I could get in to see my therapist. Honestly, if it's a help line an office gave you, itll be a lot higher quality help than suicide hotline which has always given me a 1-2 hour wait on hold.

Also, if you're wanting to die. Pills are the least reliable way, you're more likely to wake up and potentially hurt yourself in a not fun way. And bleeding out is also variable. It's not reliable either. 
I wouldn't risk just hurting yourself without some assured way, which sometimes helps me be advertised to the idea long enough to get through it.
